node.statement: Projection and nonvanishing check. The elements e_U,e_j,e_R are norm-one Hermitian projections of C^m because U and R=U union {j} are nonempty and j notin U. Unpacking the level-one part of the extended t-inclusion w gives involution preservation, ||w(xy)-w(x)w(y)||<=t||x||||y||, and (1-t)||x||<=||w(x)||<=(1+t)||x||. Hence P_U,P_j,P_R are Hermitian with idempotence defect at most t, so are t-projections by def-delta-projection. Also 1-t<=||P_R||<=1+t, so P_R satisfies the nonvanishing alternative | ||P_R||-1 |<=t<=t+epsilon_A.
